title: Project Uppercut research evidence record
$comment: One record per source. The point of this schema is not tidiness: it is that a scraped paragraph must not quietly become a gameplay formula. A record carries where it came from, whether anyone peer reviewed it, what it actually measured, and - separately and explicitly - whether this project has accepted it. Discovery is free; canon costs a decision record.

tier.description: 1 strongest authority (commissions, systematic reviews, controlled studies, official engine docs, standards). 2 useful support (single observational studies, university pages, developer interviews, patents, analytics with disclosed methods). 3 inspiration only (reviews, retrospectives, coaching articles, community analysis, video). Tier 3 may never reach canon_status accepted.

quoted_evidence.description: Short verbatim extracts ONLY, with a locator. Each quote is capped at 25 words by the validator; a record is a pointer to a source, not a copy of it.

canon_status.description: discovered: found and recorded. reviewed: a human read it and judged the method. accepted: it may inform canon, and accepted_by_decision names the decision record that says so. rejected: read and set aside, with rejected_because.
